body: Part of e553ce, after the GUI step. The test of the system: on the Pi server, an app under development on a phone (adb over USB or TCP) or an emulator on an x86 host, clicked through from the Android GUI over a bad link (the link harness or a real mobile link). Record round-trip time per tap and bytes per capture, and decide from that whether the design holds before porting to iOS. Update README with how to enable [screen].
title: screen 6: end-to-end trial on a real Android device
